## Common WHERE Filters

Almost all queries filter on partition columns:

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (appears in ~100% of queries)
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Date range filter (30-day window, common in feature engineering)
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${date}', 29) AND '${date}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')

-- Budget analysis: exclude unlimited budget campaigns
AND budget_usd != 9999999999

-- Active campaigns only
AND campaign_status = 1
AND has_ads_active = 1

-- Shop/campaign ID validity
AND shop_id > 0
AND campaign_id > 0

-- Product type exclusion (budget supply analysis)
AND main_product_type NOT IN ('Shop Ads', 'Live Ads', 'Video Ads', 'Brand Ads')

-- Budget utilization check (low budget usage)
AND campaign_valid_budget_usd > 0

-- Live Ads specific (pricing_type filter)
AND pricing_type IN (9, 10, 14)

-- ROI2 + Simple bidding
AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. JOIN with dim_advertise on campaign_id (most common)
-- Used to get ads_id, item_id, placement, pricing_type
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live dim
  ON budget.campaign_id = dim.campaign_id
  AND budget.shop_id = dim.shop_id
  AND budget.grass_date = dim.grass_date
  AND budget.grass_region = dim.grass_region

-- 2. JOIN with performance table on campaign_id + shop_id
-- Used in bidding model training data
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT campaign_id, shop_id, pricing_type,
           campaign_strategy_valid_budget_usd,
           is_auto_topup_enabled,
           account_balance_usd
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ...
) bgt ON t.campaign_id = bgt.campaign_id
     AND t.shop_id = bgt.shop_id
     AND t.pricing_type = bgt.pricing_type

-- 3. JOIN with deduction loss on campaign_id + grass_region + grass_date
-- Used in deduction loss analysis
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, campaign_id,
           budget_usd, campaign_valid_budget_usd
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ...
) c ON a.grass_region = c.grass_region
   AND a.grass_date = c.grass_date
   AND a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id

-- 4. JOIN with ads_advertiser_mkt table on campaign_id
-- Used in seller center diagnosis
JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live mkt
  ON budget.campaign_id = mkt.campaign_id

-- 5. Self-JOIN for day-over-day comparison
-- Used in budget increment analysis
FROM budget_tbl_curr JOIN budget_tbl_prev
  ON budget_tbl_curr.campaign_id = budget_tbl_prev.campaign_id
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 1. Account-level aggregation (GROUP BY shop_id, grass_region, grass_date)
-- Aggregate campaign-level budget to account level
SELECT grass_region, shop_id, grass_date,
    MAX(COALESCE(account_balance_usd, 0.0)) AS account_balance_usd,
    MAX(COALESCE(account_valid_budget_usd, 0.0)) AS account_valid_budget_usd,
    MAX(COALESCE(is_auto_topup_enabled, 0)) AS is_auto_topup_enabled,
    MAX(COALESCE(topup_amt_usd, 0.0)) AS topup_amt_usd,
    MAX(COALESCE(expired_amt_usd, 0.0)) AS expired_amt_usd,
    MAX(COALESCE(account_expenditure_usd, 0.0)) AS account_expenditure_usd
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY grass_region, shop_id, grass_date

-- 2. Budget supply total (GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type)
-- Sum campaign valid budget across all campaigns
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type,
    SUM(campaign_valid_budget_usd) AS campaign_budget
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE campaign_status = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

-- 3. Budget utilization rate check
-- Identify campaigns with low budget usage over 3 days
SELECT campaign_id
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE campaign_valid_budget_usd > 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(IF(COALESCE(ads_expenditure_usd, 0) / campaign_valid_budget_usd < 0.8, 1, 0)) = 3

-- 4. Hit budget detection (Live Ads)
-- Check if expenditure equals strategy valid budget
SELECT campaign_id, shop_id,
    ads_expenditure_usd AS campaign_expenditure_usd,
    campaign_strategy_valid_budget_usd AS campaign_daily_quota_usd,
    CASE WHEN ads_expenditure_usd / campaign_strategy_valid_budget_usd = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hit_budget
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live

-- 5. Distinct campaign count
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campaign_id_cnt
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE has_ads_active = 1

-- 6. Budget day-over-day increment analysis
SELECT
    (budget_tbl_curr.budget_usd - budget_tbl_prev.budget_usd) AS budget_incre
```

### Snippet 1: Bidding Model Training Feature (ROI2/Simple)


### Snippet 2: Shop-Level Feature Engineering (Traffic Boost)

### Snippet 4: Budget Utilization Rate (ROI2 Low Usage Detection)

```sql
-- Source: workflows/ads/platform_support/ads_sc_roi2_campaign_budget_usage_rate_3d
-- Identifies campaigns with consistently low budget utilization
SELECT campaign_id
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_3D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
```

### Snippet 7: Budget Supply Analysis (Excluding Shop/Live/Video/Brand Ads)

```sql
-- Source: sql/ads_budget_supply_1d.sql
-- Calculates total valid budget supply by pricing type
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, campaign_id, pricing_type,
    SUM(campaign_valid_budget_usd) AS campaign_budget
FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= DATE '${begin_date}'
  AND grass_date <= DATE '${end_date}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND campaign_status = 1
  AND main_product_type NOT IN ('Shop Ads', 'Live Ads', 'Video Ads', 'Brand Ads')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
```

### Snippet 8: Budget Day-over-Day Increment Analysis

```sql
-- Source: manual_tasks/andy.jiang/bidding/research/budget_analysis
-- Compares budget between consecutive days to detect budget changes
WITH budget_tbl_curr AS (
    SELECT * FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region = 'ID'
      AND grass_date = DATE'2024-11-03'
      AND has_ads_active = 1 AND budget_usd != 9999999999
), budget_tbl_prev AS (
    SELECT * FROM mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region = 'ID'
      AND grass_date = DATE'2024-11-02'
      AND has_ads_active = 1 AND budget_usd != 9999999999
)
SELECT budget_tbl_curr.campaign_id,
    (budget_tbl_curr.budget_usd - budget_tbl_prev.budget_usd) AS budget_incre
FROM budget_tbl_curr JOIN budget_tbl_prev
ON budget_tbl_curr.campaign_id = budget_tbl_prev.campaign_id
```
